ResearchTabDef.label: Narcotics
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Unlock Narcotics drug recipes. All projects require drug production from the Main tab.

ResearchProjectDef.label: percocet production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Synthesize percocet at a drug lab — a medical opioid painkiller made from neutroamine and herbal medicine.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->developed industrial opioid synthesis for frontier clinics

ResearchProjectDef.label: fentanyl production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Synthesize fentanyl at a drug lab — a potent synthetic opioid for extreme pain and surgical anesthesia, made from neutroamine and industrial medicine. Requires percocet production first.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->developed potent opioid synthesis for battlefield surgery

ResearchProjectDef.label: xanax production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Synthesize xanax at a drug lab — a medical mood stabilizer blended from neutroamine and smokeleaf extracts.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->formulated calming chem blends for stressed spacer crews

ResearchProjectDef.label: cocaine production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine coca leaves into cocaine powder at a drug lab. A hard stimulant with intense euphoria and high addiction risk.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->refined leaf alkaloids in a back-alley orbital lab
